examples.arabic: أهلاً دكتورة فاطمة، يبدو أن هناك سوء فهم؛ إذ قصدتُ أنني أُحب قضاء الوقت في المنزل، غير أنني مستعد لإجراء المقابلة الصحفية هنا الآن.
examples.english: Welcome Dr. Fatima, it seems there is a misunderstanding; as I meant that I love spending time at home, however I am ready to conduct the journalistic interview here now.
examples.transliteration: Ahlan daktoorah Fatima, yabdoo anna hunaka soo' fahm; idh qasadtu annanee uhibbu qadaa' al-waqt fee al-manzil, ghayra annanee musta'idd li-ijraa' al-muqabalah as-suhufiyyah huna al-aan.
examples.storyTitle: An Appointment on Al Mutanabbi Street

examples.english: This is my family and we have a lot of time.

examples.arabic: بينما كان يغادر البنك لاحظ زحاما مروريا خانقا فقرر أن ركوب الحافلة العامة رقم أربعين هو الخيار الوحيد للوصول في الوقت المحدد.
examples.english: While he was leaving the bank, he noticed suffocating traffic congestion, so he decided that riding public bus number forty was the only option to arrive on time.
examples.transliteration: baynama kana yughadiru al-banka lahaza zihaman mururiyyan khaniqan fa-qarrara anna rukuba al-hafilati al-'ammati raqmi arba'ina huwa al-khiyaru al-wahidu lil-wusuli fi al-waqti al-muhaddadi.
examples.storyTitle: A Race Against Time in Downtown

examples.arabic: مر بعض الوقت وهي تنظر الى الباب و تفكر في موعدها
examples.english: Some time passed as she looked at the door and thought about her appointment.
examples.transliteration: Marra ba'd al-waqt wa hiya tanzur ila al-bab wa tufakkiru fi maw'idiha.

examples.arabic: قالت الأم هذا موعد مناسب للجميع لكي نستمتع بالوقت هناك
examples.english: The mother said, "This is a suitable time for everyone so that we can enjoy the time there"
examples.transliteration: Qalat al-umm hadha maw'id munasib lil-jami'i li-kay nastamti'a bil-waqti hunak

examples.arabic: أنا أحب قضاء الوقت مع عائلتي كل يوم
examples.english: I love spending time with my family every day
examples.transliteration: Ana uhibbu qada'a al-waqti ma'a 'ailati kull yawmin
